newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Malaysian firm completes Phil Racing buy.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian firm completes Phil Racing buy.

text.p: A Malaysian firm, Leisure Management Bhd, has bought about 34 percent of Philippine Racing Club Inc (PRCI), vendor Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp (Philrealty) said on Wednesday.
Philrealty corporate secretary Sixto Sandejas told the Philippine Stock Exchange the company had unloaded 165.240 million shares of PRCI at 12.0 pesos per share on Wednesday.
After the block sale, Philrealty now holds only about 2.0 percent of PRCI.

Executive vice president Amador Bacani said the proceeds of the sale would be to partly finance its 2.5-billion peso building projects inside Fort Bonifacio city, the new business district coming up in Manila.
Philrealty is one of the major developers of the area.
Philrealty bought into PRCI two years ago, in the hope of developing the existing racetrack just outside the Makati business district into a mixed commercial-residential complex.
The project is yet to take off.
Philippine Racing is currently trading at 13.75 pesos, down from yesterday's close of 14.25 pesos. Philrealty went up 10 centavos to 1.30 pesos by midsession.
